description: Na₃PrV₂O₈ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3m1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The Na-O bond length is 2.17 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.91 Å. Pr is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form PrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. All Pr-O bond lengths are 2.35 Å. V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent PrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 18°. There is one shorter (1.68 Å) and three longer (1.76 Å) V-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one V atom.
